name: plugin.kimi_minidb
description: Zero-dependency embedded hybrid KV and document database with CRC32-checksummed write-ahead logging (WAL) and generational snapshot compaction.

entrypoints.name: kimi_minidb_put
entrypoints.description: Insert or update a document in an embedded collection with CRC32-checksummed write-ahead log (WAL) persistence.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Unique document key within the collection

entrypoints.name: kimi_minidb_get
entrypoints.description: Retrieve a stored document by collection name and key with CRC32 integrity verification.

entrypoints.name: kimi_minidb_compact
entrypoints.description: Triggers generational snapshot compaction, consolidating write-ahead logs into a clean baseline snapshot.

parameters.name: target_generation
parameters.description: Optional generation number override for the new snapshot baseline
